description: NaBaSmWO₆ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnnn space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.67 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.63 Å. There are two inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded to twelve O atoms to form BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share faces with four equivalent SmO₆ octahedra and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.93-3.02 Å. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.68 Å) and four longer (3.00 Å) Ba-O bond lengths. Sm is bonded to six O atoms to form SmO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-19°. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.34 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SmO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-19°. There are four shorter (1.96 Å) and two longer (1.97 Å) W-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Ba, one Sm, and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ba, one Sm, and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, one Sm, and one W atom.
